idea: Recursive frame-peeling search. Choose a corner square of side 1−t, then fill the L-shaped border of width t with two arms of equal squares of side t/j (stacked j deep where possible). Recurse into any rectangle left over. Enumerate t ∈ {p/q : q ≤ 12} and depth ≤ 3, keeping the exact count n via the best (count, sum) Pareto lists of the sub-rectangles.
